description: Cursor IDE rules for metamask-mobile development

rules.description: Avoid using console.log in production code. Use Logger utility instead.
rules.message: Use Logger.log() from app/util/Logger instead of console.log

rules.description: All user-facing strings must be localized via i18n.
rules.message: Use strings() from app/locales/i18n instead of hardcoded strings

rules.description: Enforce strict TypeScript types. Avoid using 'any'.
rules.message: Avoid using 'any' type. Define explicit types or use 'unknown'.

rules.description: Access Redux state via selectors, not direct state access.
rules.message: Use selectors from app/selectors/ to access Redux state

rules.description: Never store sensitive data (keys, seeds, passwords) in AsyncStorage.
rules.message: Use SecureKeychain or Vault for sensitive data storage

rules.description: New components and utilities must have corresponding test files.
rules.message: Ensure a .test.ts or .test.tsx file exists for this module

rules.description: React components must use PascalCase naming.
rules.message: Component names must be PascalCase (e.g., MyComponent)

rules.description: Avoid inline styles in React Native components. Use StyleSheet.create.
rules.message: Use StyleSheet.create() for component styles instead of inline style objects
